usedFor: Sleekplan collects customer feedback, and “Create Feedback” and “Update Feedback” add and change posts.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Feedback” in Sleekplan
bestTemplate.why: It creates a new post, so feedback from other places lands in Sleekplan.

watchOut: AI agents run on a schedule or when asked, so a post from “Create Feedback” appears at the next run.
